name: mcp-server-for-ynab
description: Connect your AI assistant to YNAB. Read-only by default, with opt-in writes that are recorded and reversible.
long_description: Exposes the YNAB API as MCP tools, plus enriched tools that answer in one call what the raw API cannot: budget health, cash position, cleanup queues, overspending, and recurring charges. Read-only unless you tick Allow writes. When writes are on, every change records the state that preceded it so it can be reverted.

ynab_api_key.title: YNAB Personal Access Token
ynab_api_key.description: Create one at app.ynab.com/settings/developer. Stored by your OS keychain, not in a file.

ynab_plan_id.title: Default plan ID (optional)
ynab_plan_id.description: Set this and you never have to name a budget in a request. Ask for your plans to find it.

ynab_allow_writes.title: Allow writes
ynab_allow_writes.description: Leave off to keep the assistant read-only. Turn on to let it change your budget; every write is recorded locally and can be reverted.
